site_name: The Hive Football Centre, Prince Edwards Playing Fields
description: Erection of an all-weather sports pitch covering enclosing the existing artificial playing pitch
decision_conditions: <p>Prior to the first use of the development hereby approved, a Fire Safety Statement, prepared and signed by a competent and accredited fire safety assessor, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p>Reason: To ensure that development incorporates appropriate fire safety measures and ensures safe access and egress for users in compliance with London Plan Policy D12.</p>
<p>The internal lighting shall be turned off no later than 15 minutes after the last use.</p><p>Reason: In the interest of protecting the neighbouring residential amenity.</p>
<p>The enclosed sports pitch hereby approved shall not be used after 22:30 hours on any day, Monday to Sunday.</p><p>Reason: In the interest of protecting the neighbouring residential amenity.</p>

<p>The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those on the approved plans 00155PLN-E and 00155PLN-A.</p><p>Reason: To safeguard the character and appearance of the area in accordance with Core Policy CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.</p><p>REASON: To comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town &amp; Country Planning Act 1990</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out and retained in accordance with the following documents and plans: 00155PLN-M, 00155PLN-K, 0015PLN-G, 00155PLN-F, 00155PLN-E, 00155PLN-D, 00155PLN-C, 00155PLN-B, 00155PLN-A, Design &amp; Access Statement and Fire Safety Statement.</p><p>REASON: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.</p>

<p>No development shall take place until a detailed construction logistics plan has first been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and agreed in writing. The plan shall detail the arrangements for:</p><p>a) The parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors;</p><p>b) Loading and unloading of plant and materials;</p><p>c) Storage of plant and materials used in construction the development;</p><p>d) The erection and maintenance of security hoardings including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing;</p><p>e) Wheel washing facilities; and</p><p>f) A scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from the construction works.</p><p>g) Measures for the control and reduction of dust</p><p>h) Measures for the control and reduction of noise and vibration</p><p>i) How traffic would be managed to minimise disruption</p><p>j) Air quality management measures</p><p>K) The duration of works</p><p>L) The type and number of construction vehicles during the busiest construction period of the works</p><p>The construction of the development shall be carried out in accordance with the plan so agreed.</p><p>Reason - To ensure that measures are put in place to manage and reduce noise and vibration impacts during construction and to safeguard the amenity of neighbouring occupiers, and to ensure that the transport network impact of the construction work associated with the development is managed. To ensure that measures are agreed and in place to manage and reduce dust, noise and vibration and transport impacts during the construction phase of the development.</p>

<p class="xmsonormal"><span style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif;">Prior to
the commencement of development (notwithstanding removal of existing fencing)
